scripts.dev:console: concurrently -n api,staff-web -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @coffee-shop/api" "npm run dev --workspace @coffee-shop/staff-web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @coffee-shop/shared && npm run build --workspace @coffee-shop/api && npm run build --workspace @coffee-shop/staff-web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @coffee-shop/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @coffee-shop/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @coffee-shop/staff-web
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml down -v && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml up -d db
